title: Workspace
subtitle: Connect a Workspace backed by GitHub and manage Workspace policy changes.
tokenPolicy: GitHub tokens are kept in sessionStorage only.

github.title: GitHub repository connection
github.subtitle: Connect the GitHub repository that backs this Workspace.

installation.title: Workspace installation
installation.subtitle: Install dispatcher workflow and governance folders for this Workspace in the connected GitHub repository.
installation.idle: Check the GitHub connection to inspect installation status.
installation.outdated: Workspace workflow files do not match the current BatchPlane template.
installation.installSuccess: Installation pull request is ready for maintainer review.
installation.updateSuccess: Workflow update pull request is ready for maintainer review.

workspacePolicy.title: Workspace policy
workspacePolicy.subtitle: Change approval behavior through a pull request to .batch-governance/workspace.yml.
workspacePolicy.idle: Check the GitHub connection to inspect Workspace policy.
workspacePolicy.selfApprovalNotice: Requester self-approval will be allowed after this policy PR is merged. The approval remains explicit evidence.
workspacePolicy.autoApproveNotice: After this policy PR is merged, execution requests are approved automatically by Workspace policy. The UI records explicit approval evidence; the dispatcher still performs workflow_dispatch.

errors.requiredFields: GitHub repository owner, repository name, and token are required.
